blocker.symptom: rebuild/2008-06/native-classes/RenderStatsItem2008.cpp(24)/(25): error C2143: syntax error : missing ';' before '<'
blocker.cause: the #ifndef NATIVE_RENDERSTATSITEM_PENDING branch requested explicit instantiations of Item::createBoundChildItem<G3D::Stopwatch> / <int>, but the organized App/include/stats/Stats.h has no such member template (only createChildItem(const char*), createBoundChildItem(const Profiling::Profiler&) and createBoundMemChildItem(const char*, const size_t&)), so the compiler parsed the '<' after a non-template name as less-than. The file's own header (native-headers/RenderStatsItem2008/RenderStatsItem2008.h lines 30-34) states the design: 'Item::createBoundChildItem<T> (proposal for the stats/Stats.h owner). Until both exist, the class is compiled only with NATIVE_RENDERSTATSITEM_PENDING against generated copies of those headers; without it the unit only instantiates the TypedStatsItem<G3D::Stopwatch> / <int> members the ctor binds.' The cpp's non-pending branch contradicted its own header.
